name: OSS_RATE_PLAN_DETERMINANTS
description: This table is used to capture rate plan determinants.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_DETERMINANT_ID
columns.description: This field uniquely identifies the specific rate plan determinant associated with each row in the dataset.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_DETERMINANT_NUMBER
columns.description: This field acts as an alternative identifier for the rate plan determinant associated with the row.

columns.name: PRICE_LIST_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the price list ID associated with the rate plan determinant.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the inventory item ID associated with the rate plan determinant.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the organization ID associated with the rate plan determinant.

columns.name: PRICE_UOM
columns.description: This field tracks the price unit of measure associated with the rate plan determinant.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the rate plan ID associated with the rate plan determinant.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: To uniquely identify and differentiate various business units within an organisation. A business unit can represent a division, department, or any distinct part of a company that operates independently or has a specific function.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: This field tracks the source system associated with the rate plan determinant.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_INSTANCE_FLAG
columns.description: This field tracks the identifier of rate plan instance associated with the rate plan determinant.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This field tracks the status associated with the rate plan determinant.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the subscription product id associated to rate plan instance.

columns.name: MASTER_CRITERIA_FLAG
columns.description: This field tracks the master criteria flag.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
